## Description

Used in [Chase Global Variable At Rate](/wiki/articles/chase+global+variable+at+rate) and [Chase Player Variable At Rate](/wiki/articles/chase+player+variable+at+rate). Specifies which of the action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. The action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.

## Options
- **Destination and Rate**
